lee: FYI we had a tenant report massive overage last night. Root cause looks like mixed-size batch where header said 1024 but one item was huge and forced slowpath.
anita: Can you paste sanitized request and preflight?
lee: sample: POST /v1/embeddings, X-Embed-Dims:1024, input=["s1","s2","<blob 12k chars>","s3"]
preflight: items=4, header=1024, inferred_max=8192, routing=split(small,small,slow,small), estimated_units=4*32=128, billed_units=32+32+512+32=608
sam: Ugh. We still rely on header for quick estimate and then split by per-item inference only for routing, not for estimate. That mismatch causes console surprises.
lee: proposal: change estimate calc to use max(header, inferred_max_sampled) for the estimate if we can cheaply sample first N items or first K bytes. Put behind flag `embed.estimate_validation=async|strict|off`.
anita: Async mode sounds good: accept request, return 200 normally, then recompute estimate in background and emit audit event + update console/billing if delta > threshold. Less latency impact.
sam: Strict/Reject mode is for enterprise only - will break current SDKs but some customers want it. We'll expose per-tenant policy in Console.
infra-bot: Created TASK-421 "embed estimate validation modes" assigned to @sam and @lee.
ui-team: For console UX, show a small annotation on the time series point when an async adjustment occurred. Also add filter "header_mismatch" in the request trace list.
lee: telemetry: metrics needed: embed.estimate_validation_attempts, embed.estimate_mismatch_count, embed.async_adjustment_amount_histogram, per-tenant tag. Also trace attr `embed.estimate_source=header|sampled|override`.
sam: Implementation notes: limit sampling to first 8KB or first 5 items to keep cost bounded. For items >100k treat as slowpath and skip sampling. Canary 3% first.
anita: I'll draft support article and SDK helper that computes dims client-side for common payloads.
lee: ok plan: implement async mode first, add metrics and console annotation, canary, then evaluate strict mode for enterprise opt-in. Thanks.
